evidence: Adjudicator 2 independent of author Worker 16 and Reviewer 1 per assignment. Dispatching -> Excluded is rejected, but an external send not represented by the model is not fenced. This is source-inspection reproduction, not an executed test or evidence of live failure. SCOPE: original spec requires missing terminal authority and prevention of premature release as applicable, default-off isolated preparation; design invariant 6 states original-bound terminal/no-send evidence and exclusion of competing send. IMPACT: model can represent exclusion without stating the essential no-send assumption and could mislead later composition; no production release is demonstrated, because this is an isolated in-memory fixture, not live authority. PRACTICALITY/ALTERNATIVES: smallest coherent remedy is fail closed for exclusion absent an explicit modeled no-send condition, or remove exclusion until such a condition is modeled; demonstrate absent/mismatched/stale assumptions and retained occupancy in disposable tests where applicable. A fixture assumption is not authentication. The pure immutable transition already makes Held -> Dispatching and Held -> Excluded mutually exclusive in one state lineage, but provides no actual cross-client CAS, sender fence or proof of external non-send. Do not mandate a specific separately authenticated fixture authority or claim that a model-only fence solves real sender concurrency. Production-grade original-bound authenticated evidence and an enforceable atomic sender boundary remain cutover prerequisites already stated in original scope, not proven or authorized by this decision. Corrective Work may be created only for the bounded model semantics/tests above; source acceptance, review verdict and cutover remain separate.
